description: Verify that DUT discards an IPv4 packet whose MF=1 with no following fragment ever arriving — the reassembly bucket times out and no Echo Reply is emitted (RFC 791 §3.2 reassembly timer)
approach:
[Objective]
MF=1 advertises 'more fragments to come'. If they never arrive, the reassembly bucket lingers consuming memory; the spec mandates a timer to clean it up. DUT must drop the bucket without delivering its partial contents.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: single IPv4 fragment with MF=1 (no continuation sent)

2. Wait > reassembly timeout (typically 60 s on Linux).

3. Observation:
   • DUT → Tester: nothing — neither Echo Reply nor Time Exceeded with our fragment's id

[Pass condition]
DUT does not emit any Echo Reply for the abandoned bucket.

[Fail condition]
Fail_dut_replied — DUT emitted an Echo Reply despite never having received the rest of the datagram.

verdicts.Pass: DUT silently dropped the lingering bucket after timeout — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_replied: DUT replied despite incomplete reassembly — partial data delivered
